title: Syrian Chicken Flatbread
description: A fusion of Chinese and Syrian flavors in this delicious flatbread recipe. The combination of savory chicken and spices creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite Chinese spices.
Bake the chicken in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, warm the Syrian flatbread in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
In a pan, sauté the chickpeas with some oil and your favorite spices until crispy.
Top the flatbread with the chicken, chickpeas, and fresh cilantro.
